metadata.title: Celestial Rainbow Arc and Lunar Phases

retrievalProfile.description: A minimalist celestial composition featuring a vibrant vertical rainbow arc against a grainy starry sky with sidebar lunar iconography and vertical sans-serif text.

recipe.visualDefinition: A tall, vertical rainbow arc glows with soft diffusion against a deep blue, grainy twilight sky filled with subtle stars. A small crescent moon sits at the center of the arc's curve. The left margin contains a clean vertical arrangement of sans-serif text and a sequence of lunar phase icons ranging from crescent to full.
coreVisualRelationships: The rainbow arc acts as a central luminous divider
Vertical text alignment mirrors the verticality of the rainbow
Grainy texture provides a tactile quality to the ethereal sky
Lunar icons provide a rhythmic graphic counterpoint to the organic arc
coreInvariants: Grainy film-like noise across the entire image
Vibrant spectral colors in the rainbow (red, orange, yellow, green, blue)
Deep indigo to cyan gradient in the background

compositionAndHierarchy.subjectPositionAndScale: The rainbow arc is the primary subject, occupying the center-right 70% of the frame. Text and icons are secondary, confined to a narrow left-side gutter.
compositionAndHierarchy.visualAnchor: The central crescent moon inside the rainbow's curve.
compositionAndHierarchy.movementAndEyePath: The eye follows the vertical rainbow arc upward, then shifts to the left margin to read the vertical text and icons from top to bottom.
compositionAndHierarchy.negativeSpace: Extensive negative space in the starry sky creates a sense of vastness and calm.

colorSystem.saturationAndValueRelationship: High saturation in the rainbow arc contrasts with the low-value, muted tones of the starry sky.

typographyAndGraphicLanguage.pairingStrategy: Single typeface used with varying orientation and icon integration.
graphicDevices: Vertical line of lunar phase icons
Soft glow effect on the rainbow

candidateDirections.reason: Geometric clarity matches the celestial theme.
Modern, clean, and professional for minimalist layouts.

twoStageComposition.backgroundInstruction: Generate a grainy, deep blue twilight sky with subtle stars. Add a vibrant, diffused vertical rainbow arc on the right side with a tiny crescent moon in its center.
twoStageComposition.overlayInstruction: Place vertical sans-serif text in the left margin, rotated 270 degrees. Between the text blocks, insert a vertical column of lunar phase icons (crescent to full).

verificationChecks: Is the rainbow arc diffused and glowing?
Is the texture grainy rather than smooth?
Is the text perfectly vertical and uppercase?
Are the lunar icons aligned in a single column?

mustRedesign: Exact sequence of lunar icons if trademarked
postGenerationChecks: Ensure the rainbow colors are spectral and not muddy
Check that the vertical text is legible and properly spaced
Verify the grain does not obscure the small crescent moon
Confirm the composition feels spacious and atmospheric
recipe.reuseFormula: Celestial Grain + Spectral Arc + Vertical Gutter Typography
